title: Correct EMF value
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the electromotive force must be 3 V.

title: Correct internal resistance
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the battery's internal resistance must be 5 Ω.

title: Initial circuit equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must write the correct Ohm's law equation for the moment the switch is closed, accounting for all resistors and internal resistance.

title: Steady-state circuit equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must write the correct Ohm's law equation for the steady state, recognizing the coil's DC resistance is negligible.

title: Solving simultaneous equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate a correct method for solving the two equations to find both unknowns.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's work and final answers should include correct units (V and Ω).

title: Ignoring coil resistance
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly includes the coil's resistance in the steady-state equation.

title: Sign or algebraic error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize for algebraic mistakes in solving the simultaneous equations that lead to incorrect intermediate or final values.
